summary.text: Sarah Wolek is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 16 who has served since April 3, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as education administrator.

paragraphs.text: Wolek was born in New York, New York.

She earned bachelor's degrees in economics and decision information sciences from the University of Maryland in 2001, a master's degree in business administration from Columbia University in 2004, and a master's degree in public policy from the University of Chicago.

Her career experience includes working as a senior faculty specialist with the University of Maryland, chief of staff for fair housing and equal opportunity at the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, and a senior policy adviser for small business at the U.S. Department of the Treasury.
She has served on the board of directors of the Bethesda Urban Partnership.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed Wolek to the House of Delegates to replace Ariana Kelly.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
